pages.title: Shop
pages.content:
Shop

The catalogue: eight field-tested tents, packs and layers, each with a spec sheet.

pages.title: Compare
pages.content:
Compare

Tents, packs and layers side by side. Weights are measured on our own scale; packed sizes are measured with the stuff sack closed.

pages.title: Rental
pages.content:
Rental

Tent rental is €38 for a weekend (Friday to Monday) or €72 for 7 days. A pack and sleep kit is €29 for a weekend. Reserve online, collect from 15:00 on Friday, return by 12:00 on Monday.

pages.title: Workshop
pages.content:
Workshop

The repair bench behind the counter: tent door zip replacement €45, fabric patch up to 10 cm €18, wash and reproof for a jacket or bag €35. Drop in, we quote within 2 working days and fix in 5 to 10 working days.

pages.title: About
pages.content:
About

Yamabiko Outdoor Supply opened in 2011 on Quarry Lane, founded by Ines Calder. Seven of us run the shop, the bench and the online orders, and all of us test what we sell.

pages.title: Visit
pages.content:
Visit

14 Quarry Lane, Harrow Gap. Tue–Fri 10:00–19:00, Sat 09:00–18:00, Sun 10:00–16:00, closed on Monday. Thursday pack-fitting evenings 18:00–19:00; repair clinic on the first Saturday, 10:00–13:00.

pages.title: Shipping & Returns
pages.content:
Shipping & Returns

Delivery is free over €120, otherwise €6.90. Every item can come back within 30 days if it does not work on the trail.

pages.title: FAQ
pages.content:
FAQ

How do I choose a tent? Start with berths and season, then compare weight and packed size on the Compare page. Not sure? Ask at the shop or rent one first.

pages.title: Contact
pages.content:
Contact

Write to us or call the shop during opening hours. Sofie Lund answers online orders and returns within one working day.

posts.title: The Mensah family: three nights at Lake Orrin
posts.excerpt: Two adults, one seven-year-old and a tent meant for two.
posts.content: Two adults, one seven-year-old and one tent that was meant to sleep two. They would do it again, with a bigger porch.

posts.title: Hanne Vos: nine days on the Grey Saddle route
posts.excerpt: Nine days solo with a 0.98 kg tent.
posts.content: Nine days solo with a 0.98 kg tent and a rain shell that stayed in the pack until day four.

posts.title: Jonas & Priya: Cairn 3 in February
posts.excerpt: Minus twelve at the hut, a calm night in the tent.
posts.content: Minus twelve at the hut, a calm night in the tent beside it, and a long list of what they would pack differently.
